events_shape_ck.name: events_shape_ck
events_shape_ck.value:
(
        "events"."event_kind" = 'date_only'
        AND "events"."local_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "events"."start_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "events"."end_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "events"."time_zone" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "events"."event_kind" = 'instant'
        AND "events"."local_date" IS NULL
        AND "events"."start_at_utc" IS NOT NULL
        AND "events"."end_at_utc" IS NOT NULL
        AND "events"."start_at_utc" < "events"."end_at_utc"
        AND "events"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL
      )

events_cancelled_at_ck.name: events_cancelled_at_ck
events_cancelled_at_ck.value:
("events"."status" = 'active' AND "events"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("events"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "events"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

finance_entries_merchant_ck.name: finance_entries_merchant_ck
finance_entries_merchant_ck.value: "finance_entries"."merchant" IS NULL OR length("finance_entries"."merchant") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

finance_entries_note_ck.name: finance_entries_note_ck
finance_entries_note_ck.value: "finance_entries"."note" IS NULL OR length("finance_entries"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

finance_entries_deleted_at_ck.name: finance_entries_deleted_at_ck
finance_entries_deleted_at_ck.value:
("finance_entries"."status" = 'active' AND "finance_entries"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("finance_entries"."status" = 'deleted' AND "finance_entries"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

list_items_lifecycle_ck.name: list_items_lifecycle_ck
list_items_lifecycle_ck.value:
("list_items"."status" = 'open' AND "list_items"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "list_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("list_items"."status" = 'completed' AND "list_items"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "list_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("list_items"."status" = 'deleted' AND "list_items"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

lists_deleted_at_ck.name: lists_deleted_at_ck
lists_deleted_at_ck.value:
("lists"."status" = 'active' AND "lists"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("lists"."status" = 'deleted' AND "lists"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

notes_deleted_at_ck.name: notes_deleted_at_ck
notes_deleted_at_ck.value:
("notes"."status" = 'active' AND "notes"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("notes"."status" = 'deleted' AND "notes"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

reminder_recurrences_lifecycle_ck.name: reminder_recurrences_lifecycle_ck
reminder_recurrences_lifecycle_ck.value:
("reminder_recurrences"."status" = 'active' AND "reminder_recurrences"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("reminder_recurrences"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "reminder_recurrences"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_due_shape_ck.name: tasks_due_shape_ck
tasks_due_shape_ck.value:
(
        "tasks"."due_kind" = 'none'
        AND "tasks"."due_date_local" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."due_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."time_zone" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "tasks"."due_kind" = 'date_only'
        AND "tasks"."due_date_local" IS NOT NULL
        AND "tasks"."due_at_utc" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."time_zone" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "tasks"."due_kind" = 'instant'
        AND "tasks"."due_date_local" IS NULL
        AND "tasks"."due_at_utc" IS NOT NULL
        AND "tasks"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL
      )

tasks_completed_at_ck.name: tasks_completed_at_ck
tasks_completed_at_ck.value:
("tasks"."status" = 'open' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

user_preferences_quiet_hours_ck.name: user_preferences_quiet_hours_ck
user_preferences_quiet_hours_ck.value:
("user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" IS NULL)
          OR ("user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
              AND "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
              AND "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" <> "user_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute")
